start_here: Say to your AI: "Read the photo attached to message 7 in my Messages, as a JPEG no wider or taller than 1600 pixels." It runs tool:read-a-message-attachment-on-this-mac on this Mac and answers the picture's bytes with its media type and length, so the Messages screen can show it inline.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it reads one attachment of this Mac's Messages database and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Give the attachment as its row id in Messages (a whole number, such as 7) or its guid, and say whether to answer it as original or as a jpeg.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-a-message-attachment-on-this-mac and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: attachment with id, media_type and byte_length, and bytes_base64 for the picture; or refused with a code and said, which names the setting or the step to change. A file over 700 KiB is refused as too_big: ask again with as jpeg and a smaller most_px.

worked_examples.title: Show a photo from a message as a JPEG
worked_examples.ask: Read the photo attached to message 7 in my Messages, as a JPEG no wider or taller than 1600 pixels.
worked_examples.given: The input {"attachment":7,"as":"jpeg","most_px":1600} for an attachment row that holds a HEIC photo.
